title: Circular Vault Run
commonMistakes: Letting a selection contain both the first and last room
Returning zero for a ring that contains exactly one room
Using the wrong half-open endpoint when removing the first or last room
Forgetting that skipping a room keeps the better of the two previous states
followUps: How would you return the chosen rooms as well as the total?
What changes if the ring has `k` rooms that are mutually adjacent?
How would the solution handle negative room values when opening a room is optional?
attribution: Original problem by the Base Case contributors.
